summary.name: Kinetic Typography (explicit; category Motion Design and Cinematography). Provenance is explicit in the source.
summary.visualIdentity: Text carries the narrative through size, weight, spacing, position and movement order. Words stay real DOM text on a measured baseline grid, not particles. Movement follows meaning, uses clear reading holds, keeps alignment and reading continuity, and avoids identical spring motion on every letter.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: quotes, manifestos and copy-led spots. Inferred from good-fit lists: concise statements, music-timed lyric or promo pieces with a supplied track, and grid-based corporate announcements. Motion references advise omitting dense explanatory text, so that use is unsuitable.
summary.limitations: Copy must be concise, since dense text conflicts with this style. Colour checks cover only opaque two-colour pairs, so composited frames need verification. Font-to-path conversion (opentype.js) is not in the tool pool and is reported as missing, so glyph-deformation recipes need authored SVG outlines. Beat sync is unverified without audio analysis.
summary.palette: Background #FAF5E9 and text #252D39 are layout roles; one #B84F3F accent marks one word. This is a style-compatible suggestion used only when no approved palette is supplied; supplied exact colours override it. Gradients are disabled. Text on background measures 12.757:1. Cream text on #B84F3F measures 4.565:1 against a 4.5 target. The recipe palette #102820/#F4E9D5/#F2B544 applies only if explicitly adopted.
summary.motionAndInteraction: A paused GSAP timeline animates size, variable-font weight, tracking and position per word, with varied ease and duration and reading holds. The architectural recipe uses MorphSVGPlugin to bend only load-bearing glyph paths, such as a T lintel, and hides unrelated transitions under occlusion. The 3s preview holds the phrase 0–1.2s, turns the key word into a lintel 1.2–2.2s, then holds the final composition. Interaction beyond timed playback is unspecified.
summary.audio: No audio layer is mandated, so music, voiceover, effects or silence depend on the task brief. Reading holds need quiet space, so speech intelligibility takes priority over music. Beat-timed word entrances require analysed audio, and the source references did not verify beat sync. No audio assets are supplied and none should be invented; the final sound design is unspecified.
summary.assetRequirements: Exact task copy is required and supplied through the task's copy input. Load fonts locally, including a variable-weight font for weight animation, and await document.fonts.ready before measuring. Use glyph spans only where meaning requires them. Authored SVG outlines are needed for the architectural recipe. ScrambleText is optional for short titles. Photography is not required and would dilute the text-first narrative.
summary.combinations: Style-105 supplies timing: a beat map from the actual track schedules entrances and holds, the accent marks only stressed words, and words should not all start on one beat. Style-001 supplies layout: a Swiss column grid with baseline alignment, only cream, ink and red tokens, one sans family, and horizontal or vertical motion along grid axes. Diagonal free-floating motion breaks the grid and should be avoided.
summary.productionApproach: Style renderer: HTML/CSS for real text and SVG only where deformation is needed. Motion engine: GSAP with MorphSVGPlugin, with one owner per animated property. Motion and Anime.js would duplicate GSAP, so they are optional only through a verified adapter. chroma.js is optional for colour validation. Pipeline: HyperFrames by default, with Remotion as fallback only when a verified limitation is recorded.
